qwen35-2b-q4km.title: Qwen3.5 2B Q4_K_M · 262k
qwen35-2b-q4km.description: Unsloth Q4_K_M GGUF of Qwen3.5 2B. 262k native context; non-thinking chat is used by default.

phi4-mini-q4km.title: Phi-4 Mini Q4_K_M · 128k
phi4-mini-q4km.description: Community GGUF conversion of Microsoft Phi-4 Mini Instruct, quantized Q4_K_M. 128k native context.

lfm2-1b2-q4km.title: LFM2 1.2B Q4_K_M · 128k
lfm2-1b2-q4km.description: Liquid AI LFM2-1.2B, a hybrid conv/attention model built for on-device use, official Q4_K_M GGUF. 128k native context. Licensed under the LFM Open License 1.0, which caps commercial use below 10M USD annual revenue and requires shipping the license text with the model.

qwen25-0b5-q4km.title: Qwen2.5 0.5B Q4_K_M · 32k
qwen25-0b5-q4km.description: Official Qwen2.5 0.5B Instruct Q4_K_M GGUF from the Qwen organisation. 32k native context; the smallest writer in the app, added to test whether a 2 GB phone can hold a faster research turn. Quality and peak memory are not measured yet.
